relevance_note: The paper describes five named LAD patients with ITGB2 genotypes, e.g. "Patient R was homozygous for this mutation."
method_note: Built with a short Python script from my own reading; every span checked verbatim by script. Labels: the paper names patients by letters (K, I, S, R, M); I used 'Patient <letter>' for all five for consistency. Sex: the paper says 'one boy and four girls' and refers to patient K as 'his', so K is male and the other four female by deduction (both spans quoted). Four unrelated families for five patients, so two patients are relatives, but the paper does not say which; family labels not reported (paternity testing is in 'family KH', probably K's family, not recorded). Variants are printed without 'c.'/'p.' prefixes (1497delG, 1920delG, G284S, R593C); cDNA numbering is per Table 1 legend (+1 = A of ATG); I copied them as printed into cdna/protein fields. Patient M's 1497delG comes from 'all the patients have a deletion of the G at position 1497' and the Discussion; M's zygosity from 'The four other patients were compound heterozygous'. Patient R is homozygous and both parents carry 1497delG; the inheritance enum has no 'both parents' value, so I used 'inherited unspecified parent'. Parents of K were tested negative for R593C (rows kept, no variant rows; their 1497delG status is not stated). Previously published people included under v4 scope: ref [16] patient (homozygous G284S), ref [17] patient (R593C as a parental allele), ref [20] patient (de novo N351S described in words; inheritance left not reported because no parental testing is stated). Multi-citation mentions ([16, 17], [16, 20], [22, 23] etc.) and the five unpublished children were not given rows. Features: 'They all had delayed umbilical cord separation and suffered recurrent infections' applied to the five as a named-group statement; normal CD3/CD4/CD8/CD19/HLA DR expression recorded as excluded abnormal expression (D-27); normal-sized CD18 mRNA on Northern blot not recorded as a feature. Contradictions/oddities: Discussion says 'our patient who is a compound heterozygous G284S-1497delG' (singular) while Results name two such patients (S and I); Figure 3 legend says 'patients S and S' and 'changing a C into a G' for G284S, whereas the text says a G to A transition. No stacked cells.
